description:
Writing to a FILE column. Live-verified: a FILE column accepts THREE things, and each behaves differently. A stage-path STRING is RESOLVED against the stage on write, so the row ends up holding the full descriptor of the real file - reading it back gives the file's metadata, not the path string that was written - and a path that names nothing fails with 'DML operation to table W failed on column F with error: Remote file ... was not found.'. An UPDATE re-resolves, so the stored content type changes to the new file's. A metadata OBJECT is validated structurally and stored AS GIVEN, WITHOUT being resolved, so its caller-supplied ETAG survives even though no such file exists on the stage; an object carrying an unknown field is rejected on write, naming the field. NULL is stored as NULL and IS NULL still finds it. Converted 1:1 from functions/file/FileColumnWriteTest (now retired). The Java staged its fixtures by writing bytes into a file:// stage from Java; the converted tests stage them in pure SQL with COPY INTO @st/<name> ... COMPRESSION = NONE SINGLE = TRUE, which produces an exactly-named staged file - measured to give byte-identical fixtures (hello.txt is 24 bytes and text/plain, exactly as the Java's 'hello world
second line
' was).

steps.sql: CREATE STAGE st
CREATE TABLE src (a VARCHAR)
INSERT INTO src VALUES ('hello world'),('second line')
COPY INTO @st/hello.txt FROM src FILE_FORMAT = (TYPE = 'CSV' COMPRESSION = NONE) SINGLE = TRUE OVERWRITE = TRUE
CREATE TABLE w (id INTEGER, f FILE)
INSERT INTO w SELECT 1, '@st/hello.txt'
SELECT FL_GET_RELATIVE_PATH(f) FROM w WHERE id = 1
SELECT FL_GET_SIZE(f) FROM w WHERE id = 1
SELECT FL_GET_CONTENT_TYPE(f) FROM w WHERE id = 1
SELECT FL_GET_STAGE(f) FROM w WHERE id = 1
CREATE STAGE st
CREATE TABLE src (a VARCHAR)
INSERT INTO src VALUES ('not really a png but the name decides')
COPY INTO @st/image_real.png FROM src FILE_FORMAT = (TYPE = 'CSV' COMPRESSION = NONE) SINGLE = TRUE OVERWRITE = TRUE
CREATE TABLE w (id INTEGER, f FILE)
INSERT INTO w SELECT 2, TO_FILE('@st/image_real.png')
SELECT FL_GET_CONTENT_TYPE(f) FROM w WHERE id = 2
SELECT FL_GET_FILE_TYPE(f) FROM w WHERE id = 2
CREATE STAGE st
CREATE TABLE src (a VARCHAR)
INSERT INTO src VALUES ('hello world'),('second line')
COPY INTO @st/hello.txt FROM src FILE_FORMAT = (TYPE = 'CSV' COMPRESSION = NONE) SINGLE = TRUE OVERWRITE = TRUE
CREATE TABLE src2 (a VARCHAR)
INSERT INTO src2 VALUES ('col1,col2'),('1,2')
COPY INTO @st/plain.csv FROM src2 FILE_FORMAT = (TYPE = 'CSV' COMPRESSION = NONE FIELD_OPTIONALLY_ENCLOSED_BY = NONE) SINGLE = TRUE OVERWRITE = TRUE
CREATE TABLE w (id INTEGER, f FILE)
INSERT INTO w SELECT 1, '@st/hello.txt'
UPDATE w SET f = '@st/plain.csv' WHERE id = 1
SELECT FL_GET_CONTENT_TYPE(f) FROM w WHERE id = 1
SELECT FL_GET_RELATIVE_PATH(f) FROM w WHERE id = 1
CREATE STAGE st
